summary: Items whose only reliable source in the base game is a hostile creature, and what replaces the creature in the simulation world (D-094). A root with a route is obtainable without luck and without hunting; a root with route null is needed by nothing that the game offers as progression. docs/technical/monster-resources.md explains the audit; scripts/audit_item_sources.py and ProgressionAuditGameTests enforce it.

routes_kinds.exchange: sold by a finite, shared regional-exchange line (content/gameplay/survival-supply.json): price, small shelf, slow refill, no stockpile
routes_kinds.recipe: crafted from ordinary materials by a recipe that ships with a pinned mod (verified against the loaded recipes)
routes_kinds.derived: crafted from another root that has a route, by a base-game recipe
routes_kinds.byproduct: a by-product of a livestock chain that ships with a pinned mod

minecraft:gunpowder.gameplay: every TaCZ cartridge and rocket, Modern Life bullets, vehicle munitions, fireworks

route.why: TaCZ ships a recipe: one flint, two sugar and three charcoal make three gunpowder. It is a small production chain (sugar cane, a kiln, gravel), neither unlimited nor a creeper hunt.

minecraft:string.gameplay: every backpack and backpack upgrade, copper canteen, hammocks, vehicle seat harnesses, guitar, road markers

route.why: Valewood's mills and Ironhaven's workshops sell it by the hank at a few credits; the shelf is small and refills slowly.

minecraft:slime_ball.gameplay: sticky pistons (pickup and restock backpack upgrades), vehicle plastic, leads

route.why: Ironhaven's polymer works sell the little they make.

minecraft:ender_pearl.gameplay: the magnet and feeding backpack upgrades

route.why: A rare import through the port of Blackwater: expensive and one at a time.

minecraft:blaze_rod.gameplay: fifteen heavier TaCZ firearms and attachments (Desert Eagle, AWP, M249, minigun and others), blaze powder

route.why: Military surplus that reaches the port of Blackwater now and then: the premium weapons stay scarce and costly.

minecraft:blaze_powder.gameplay: vehicle engines, explosives and solid fuel, cocktails

route.why: Two powder from one rod, by the base game's own recipe.
A slime ball and blaze powder, by the base game's own recipe.

minecraft:spider_eye.gameplay: Vinery's two special wines (and fermented spider eyes)

route.why: The apothecary in Valewood sells a few for the vintners.

minecraft:bone.gameplay: Farmer's Delight bone broth, a few vehicle ornaments, Farm & Charm bone meal (bone meal itself comes from a composter)

route.why: Cutting a ham with a knife leaves a bone; hams come from livestock.

minecraft:rotten_flesh.gameplay: Farmer's Delight dog food and one compost recipe, Farm & Charm fertilizer (which has another recipe)

minecraft:nether_star.gameplay: beacons and two disabled backpack upgrades

minecraft:wither_skeleton_skull.gameplay: the Wither, one disabled backpack upgrade

minecraft:totem_of_undying.gameplay: a resurrection item no design asks for

exclusions.why: Pet food; pets eat meat from the butcher and no work order or skill asks for it. Rotten flesh has no route because nothing the game offers as progression needs it.
Decorative furniture and barrier variants made of prismarine; the same furniture exists in other materials.

approved_scopes.why: Every recipe result of these mods is treated as approved gameplay: if it needs a root above, the root must have a route (or the result is listed in exclusions with a reason).
